_comment: Named solver configurations. args are CaDiCaL options; the runner adds --lrat=1 (proof policy) and --fpc=1 (telemetry) unless the config sets --fpc itself. All use the patched binary (build/fpc) unless variant says otherwise; M0/M1 showed fpc=0/1 reproduce upstream search exactly.

D.description: stock default (NATIVE): saved/target phases with rephasing, positive initial phase

Iminus_noR.description: negative initial phase without rephasing (rephase-matched control for Fminus)

S_saved.description: pure saved phases (negative fallback), no target, no rephasing

P_neg.description: track P: native configuration, free decisions forced negative

Dupstream.description: unpatched upstream binary, stock default (M1 overhead reference)

sw1k_C.description: replay branch: NATIVE prefix, switch to NEGATIVE (track C) at first restart after 1e3 conflicts

sw1k_P.description: replay branch, track P switch to negative decisions at 1e3

sw1k_Crev.description: reverse replay branch: NEGATIVE prefix (identical to F-), switch to NATIVE (track C) at first restart after 1000 conflicts

sw10k_Crev.description: reverse replay branch: NEGATIVE prefix (identical to F-), switch to NATIVE (track C) at first restart after 10000 conflicts

sw100k_Crev.description: reverse replay branch: NEGATIVE prefix (identical to F-), switch to NATIVE (track C) at first restart after 100000 conflicts

sw1k_Cin.description: replay branch from an I- prefix: NATIVE_INIT_NEG=(forcephase 0, phase 0) from variable creation (identical to Iminus), switch to NEGATIVE (track C) at first restart after 1000 conflicts

sw10k_Cin.description: replay branch from an I- prefix: NATIVE_INIT_NEG=(forcephase 0, phase 0) from variable creation (identical to Iminus), switch to NEGATIVE (track C) at first restart after 10000 conflicts

sw100k_Cin.description: replay branch from an I- prefix: NATIVE_INIT_NEG=(forcephase 0, phase 0) from variable creation (identical to Iminus), switch to NEGATIVE (track C) at first restart after 100000 conflicts
